summary: STERIS Irish FinCo Unlimited Company, an indirect wholly owned Irish subsidiary of STERIS plc, filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for $750 million of 5.650% senior notes due 2033 and $750 million of 5.875% senior notes due 2036, fully and unconditionally guaranteed on a senior unsecured basis by STERIS plc, STERIS Corporation and STERIS Limited. Interest pays semi-annually from June 15, 2027; minimum denominations $150,000. Proceeds relate to STERIS Corporation's October 11, 2026 agreement to acquire Xodus Medical, Inc., though the offering is not conditioned on closing. Notes carry special mandatory redemption if the deal fails or is not completed by the January 11, 2028 outside date. Watch spread widening and deal-completion risk tied to the redemption trigger.
